description: A copy of the r-fmt-2b-w-accdb fixture (123 pages; page 122, Au4's old data page, is the only free page inside the file). Au1: tdef 107, usage maps 108, PK root 109, ten rows (IDs 1-10, 21-23 bytes) on data page 110. Pg: tdef 52, usage maps 53 (owned {55, 56, 57}, FreeMap {57}), PK root 54, 12 rows of ID and eight Text(255) fields of 61 U+20AC (1004 bytes each); rows 1-4 fill page 55 with 58 bytes free. One session runs UPDATE Pg SET T1 = 31 U+20AC WHERE ID = 2 (row 2, the second of page 55, 60 bytes smaller) and closes. Asks the in-place rule for a smaller row: where it lands, what moves, the slot and free words. Each session opens the database shared read/write through DAO, runs its statements with dbFailOnError (RecordsAffected read), and closes, with the DBEngine alive. Each read keeps page 0 bytes 3584-3591 and pages 1, 53, 55; after Close every page's hash too.
retentionNote: r-q17-growth round 1 (W-05/growth-structural-closure, zfrp): kept pages that decide the growth rule; see qualified.md
